purpose: Product truth artifact. Distinguishes source/test evidence from runtime evidence. Nothing here is RUNTIME_VERIFIED: that requires live-environment evidence that unit/contract tests cannot provide.

rules: status=TESTED_LOCAL means automated tests pass locally; it is not runtime evidence.
ci is CI_PENDING until a GitHub run on the exact commit is observed.
runtimeQualification is RUNTIME_VERIFIED only with live-environment evidence recorded in the repository.

capabilities.runtimePath: Embedding gateway (self-hosted OpenAI-compatible /v1/embeddings first, optional opt-in external) -> same-model cosine hybrid scoring; lexical fallback on any failure
capabilities.knownLimitation: No real embedding server (Ollama/vLLM/llama.cpp) has been run: only an in-process fake transport. No vector index; semantic scoring is brute-force over the DB-prefiltered candidate set. Vectors from a different or unrecorded embedding model are ignored (lexical only), so existing rows need re-embedding after a model change. External embeddings require EMBEDDING_ALLOW_EXTERNAL=true. Semantic candidates are a bounded brute-force window (RETRIEVAL_SEMANTIC_SCAN_LIMIT, default 1000 newest same-model rows per workspace), not an ANN index.

capabilities.runtimePath: MySQL-backed durable tasks: server/tasks (store, worker), tRPC tasks.get/list/cancel; leases + attempt fencing, checkpoint/resume, bounded retry, durable cancel, idempotent create, effect dedupe, Provider Gateway-governed model calls
capabilities.knownLimitation: Verified on local MariaDB 10.11 only (MySQL 8 CI pending). No product feature enqueues tasks yet and no worker is started by the server: the execution substrate is SOURCE_IMPLEMENTED and tested, not wired to a user-facing workflow. Side effects are at-least-once with durable dedupe records (a crash between the effect and its record repeats it); handlers must use idempotent operations. Cancellation of a running task is cooperative (next checkpoint).
